title: Player nationality filter requires an exact (folded) country match
evidence: lib/brazilian_soccer/players.ex:33 `p.nationality_fold == nat`; only Brazil has aliases (players.ex:72-74), so e.g. "Argentine" won't match "Argentina"
suggestion: Fold+contains or alias other common demonyms; Brazilian-focused spec makes this low-impact
